abilities.Unseen Fist: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.
abilities.Transistor: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.3 while using an Electric-type attack.
abilities.Dragon's Maw: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Dragon-type attack.
abilities.Chilling Neigh: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.
abilities.Grim Neigh: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.
abilities.As One (Glastrier): Combination of the Unnerve and Chilling Neigh Abilities.
abilities.As One (Spectrier): Combination of the Unnerve and Grim Neigh Abilities.
